name: web-light-transactions-dashboard-tablet-with-glass-coins
title: Light Transactions Dashboard on Tablet with Glass Coins
whatItIs: A cropped cover with a dark hand holding a tablet showing a light transactions dashboard with a sidebar, three colourful gradient summary cards, filters and a table with green, red and orange status pills, while translucent glass coins float above and a logo sits top left.
whatItMeans: Colourful mesh cards lift a data table, and glass coins add a playful money metaphor to a business tool.
techniques: Mesh gradient summary cards above a plain table
Status pills in three semantic colours
Glass coin objects behind the tablet
Tight crop showing the UI at an angle

vocabulary.definition: A coloured rounded label showing a state like completed or cancelled.
A card filled with a multi-colour gradient blend.
A grid of rows and columns for records.
